connector.name: Ask Claude
connector.registryDescription: Bridge Codex and other MCP clients with Anthropic Claude Code CLI for read-only second opinions
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package claude-mcp. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the lykhoyda account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.

env.name: GMCPT_LOG_LEVEL
